REGIONAL PARTNERSHIP

A dedicated connection to the Middle East.

Emirates Pearl General Trading (EPGT) is presented as Rigel’s sole and exclusive official partner in the Middle East.

A clear point of contact.

The partnership provides an identified route for discussions about the Rigel portfolio, product information and regional availability. Professional enquiries should identify the product, organisation and market so that the appropriate documentation can be requested.

What to ask for.

Request the current product leaflet, applicable local authorisation details, available presentations and supply documentation. Commercial availability and prescribing suitability are separate questions, and both require information for the relevant market.
